title: Squat Every Day by Cory Gregory
author: Javier Guzman
desc:
Squatting every day isn’t just about building legs—it’s about building a stronger human. Mentally, physically, and emotionally.

From managing tough days to stacking wins that carry into real life, daily squats forge toughness you can’t fake.

What used to feel heavy will one day feel easy… that’s the magic of Squat Every Day.
